$note.xp.base: Lifetime class mastery XP needed for the first claimed level.
$note.xp.growth: Exponential increase per mastery level; 1.25 brings twenty levels to about 17,000 XP.
$note.xp.roundTo: Round each mastery level cost to this many XP.
$note.xp.maxLevel: Highest class mastery level. XP earned beyond it stays on the profile.
$note.pay.perWin: Mastery XP for an ordinary fight won.
$note.pay.perElite: Mastery XP for an elite fight won, replacing the ordinary award.
$note.pay.perBoss: Mastery XP for a boss fight won, replacing the ordinary award.
$note.pay.perQuest: Mastery XP for a completed quest.
$note.corePoolShare: Minimum share of each class card pool available before any mastery unlock.
